cards.text: Jeremiah, the LORD's prophet, tells this one himself: the word of the LORD comes to him again. And friend, this time it starts with Jeremiah's own life.

cards.question: The LORD tells Jeremiah he must not marry or have sons or daughters in this place.

cards.text: Then the LORD speaks about the sons and daughters born in this place, and the mothers and fathers who had them. Brace yourself, friend. This part is heavy.

cards.question: What does the LORD say these families in Jeremiah's land will die from?

answers.text: A great flood over the land
Fire raining down from the sky

cards.question: The LORD says the people who die this way will be mourned and buried.

cards.text: Then comes another command for Jeremiah. Don't enter a house where there's a funeral meal, and don't go to mourn or show sympathy. Friend, that's a hard one, because showing up for grieving folks is what good neighbors DO.

cards.question: Why does the LORD tell Jeremiah to stay away from the funeral meal?

answers.text: He has removed His peace from this people
Jeremiah has to stay clean for the temple
The family has turned against Jeremiah

cards.text: Both great and small will die in this land. Nobody will cut himself or shave his head for them, the way mourners did.

cards.question: Even then, the LORD says, someone will still bring food to comfort the people mourning in Jeremiah's land.

cards.text: Then the LORD adds that Jeremiah must not enter a house where there's feasting, to sit down and eat and drink. No funerals AND no parties? Friend, I spent YEARS in a junk drawer, and even my calendar had more going on.

cards.question: The LORD says He will remove something from this place 'before your very eyes and in your days.' What is it?

answers.text: The sounds of joy and gladness
The walls and gates of the city
The king and his whole army

cards.text: The LORD tells Jeremiah what happens when he delivers all this to the people. And I'll be honest, friend, if somebody handed me news like this, I'd have questions too.

cards.question: What will the people ask Jeremiah after he tells them all these things?

answers.text: What sin have we committed against the LORD
How long until the LORD forgives us
Why should we listen to a prophet

cards.text: Jeremiah doesn't have to make anything up. The LORD hands him the answer to tell them, and it starts with their fathers.

cards.question: The LORD says the people's fathers abandoned Him and followed other ___.

cards.text: Then the LORD says the people now have done more evil than their fathers. Friend, that is one family record you NEVER want to break.

cards.question: The LORD says each of the people follows the ___ of his evil heart instead of obeying Him.

cards.text: So the LORD will cast them out of this land, into a land neither they nor their fathers have known. And there they'll serve other gods day and night. Other gods were their pick, friend. Now it's around the clock.

cards.question: In that unknown land, the LORD says He will show the people favor.

cards.text: Then the message turns: 'Yet behold, the days are coming,' declares the LORD. In those days, people will no longer swear 'As surely as the LORD lives' by the God who brought the Israelites up out of Egypt.

cards.question: In those coming days, what will people say the LORD brought the Israelites up out of?

answers.text: The land of the north and other lands
The land of Moab and Edom

cards.question: The LORD promises to return the Israelites to the land He gave their forefathers.

cards.text: But that homecoming is later. 'But for now,' the LORD says, He will send for many fishermen, and they will catch them.

cards.question: After the fishermen, the LORD says He will send for many ___.

cards.text: Those hunters will hunt them down on every mountain and hill, even from the clefts of the rocks. Nets in the water, hunters in the hills. Friend, this picture is as serious as it gets.

cards.question: The LORD says some of the people's ways are hidden from His face.
With His eyes on all their ways, what does the LORD say He will first do to the people?

answers.text: Repay them double for their sin
Send them a brand new prophet

cards.text: The LORD says why: they defiled His land with the carcasses of their detestable idols, and filled His inheritance with their abominations. Notice whose land it is, friend. Not theirs. HIS.
Then Jeremiah himself speaks to the LORD: 'O LORD, my strength and my fortress, my refuge in the day of distress.' And he sees something BIG coming.

cards.question: Jeremiah says the nations will come to the LORD from the ends of the earth.

cards.text: And when the nations come, they get real honest about what was handed down to them.

cards.question: The nations say their fathers inherited nothing but ___ and worthless idols.

cards.text: Then the nations ask the big one: 'Can man make gods for himself?'

cards.question: How do the nations answer their own question about the gods people make for themselves?

cards.text: Making your own god is like me stamping a cookie and then asking the cookie to run my bakery. Then the LORD speaks: He will inform them, and this time He will make them know His power and His might.

cards.question: When the LORD makes them know His power and His might, what will they know?

answers.text: That His name is the LORD
